description: Every World Bank indicator, queryable offline, with cross-country SQL and rankings no wrapper has.

novel_features.name: Offline indicator search
novel_features.description: Search the full ~16,000-indicator catalog by keyword in a single call.

novel_features.name: Cross-country compare
novel_features.description: Line up one indicator across many countries in a single aligned table with deltas vs a baseline.

novel_features.name: Trend / growth stats
novel_features.description: CAGR, year-over-year change, min/max/latest for one country+indicator series.

novel_features.name: Rank countries
novel_features.description: Rank all economies by an indicator for a year, filtered by region or income level.

novel_features.name: Pipeline export
novel_features.description: Bulk country x indicator pull emitted as pipeline-ready wide or long CSV.

novel_features.name: Revision diff
novel_features.description: Compare a fresh pull against the last synced snapshot to surface revised observations.
